name: Cold Cut Scramble + Cheerios
ingredients: 2 oz roasted chicken/turkey cold cuts, chopped
instructions: Scramble cold cuts with eggs and spinach/veggies. Serve with Cheerios in almond milk (sweetened to taste) and berries on the side.

name: Starbucks-Style Baked Egg Bites
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese (start with full cup)
1 cup green veggies (spinach, bell pepper), chopped
salt, pepper, hot sauce to taste
optional: up to 2 tbsp shredded gruyere
instructions: Cook turkey bacon until crisp, dice. Blend egg, egg whites, cottage cheese, cornstarch, salt/pepper/hot sauce (+ gruyere if using) until smooth. Fold in chopped veggies or layer with bacon in a greased muffin tin, filling wells ~3/4 full. Bake at 300F with a water-bath tray on the lower oven rack, 20-25 min until set. Rest 5 min. Yields ~5-6 bites.
source: Personalized (adapted from Once Upon a Chef bacon gruyere egg bites)
notes: Uses the Snack #7 cottage cheese portion — skip a snack that day, or eat leftover cottage cheese as the snack if using less than a full cup.

name: Ezekiel French Toast
ingredients: coconut oil spray or olive oil spray
instructions: Whisk egg + 1/4 cup egg whites. Dip Ezekiel bread slices, pan-cook with oil spray. Top with cinnamon + splenda/stevia. Serve with a side of 1/2 cup egg whites scrambled with spinach.
